text:
maya: FYI ran into a weird billing diff on the canary yesterday. client retried -> routed to fallback model -> stream truncated by toolcall => appears to have charged twice. anyone seen this pattern?
kevin: ugh. do you have request IDs / route info? that flow is tricky with our provisional vs confirmed ledger.
maya: yep saved logs. route_id=r-42, session=svc-88, client request id 0b9f. here's the truncated payload we saw:
maya: ```json
{
  "id": "0b9f",
  "model": "gpt-open-5b",
  "route": "r-42",
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name":"search","status":"truncated","kb":"kb-23"}
  ],
  "stream": "...<partial>"
}
```
kevin: that truncation + tool call likely created a provisional charge for the original route then a confirmed charge for fallback when the client reconnected. we don't currently tie provisional->confirmed across route swaps.
sara: console side is confusing too — the cost breakdown page shows "provisional credits" separate from final, but the rollup UI hides route metadata. ops flagged a customer ticket because they saw two invoices.
alex: sounds like we need to tag provisional ledger entries with a resume_token or handshake id so replays/stitching can dedupe across route hops. current ledger key is just session+prefix which breaks when we hand off to another model pool.
kevin: agree. also think we should have a short TTL on provisional entries plus a reconciliation job that attempts to merge confirmed matches within that window.
devex: UX ask: can we at least show the route transfer reason in the console tooltip? "fallback due to capacity/circuit-breaker" would help CS triage. right now it's just "fallback: true" which is not actionable.
maya: can we push a quick repro script? i can generate a replay with a forced fallback. kevin, wanna own the verification so billing doesn't regress?
kevin: i'll take verification. plan: (1) instrument provisional entries with route_id + resume_token, (2) add merge step in billing recon that looks up confirmed matches within 30s, (3) update console to surface transfer reason.
sara: for short term, can we add a console alert that highlights sessions with both provisional and confirmed charges within a small window? would reduce noisy support tickets.
alex: also posting a telemetry event schema change here: add fields [route_id, prev_route_id, resume_token, transfer_reason] to inference.events.v1, non-breaking.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-318 — assigned eng-platform. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-318 :rotating_light:
kevin: thanks bot. i'll draft a tiny RFC for the ledger key change and recon job, target ship in next patch. will coordinate with billing for safeties.
devex: once you have the schema i'll mock the console tooltip and a small banner for CS.
maya: thanks team. i'll attach logs and a sample repro to the incident ticket.
kevin: leaving a note: watch out for toolcall retries — if a toolcall is idempotent we should avoid provisional separate charges when it's retried during stream resume.
alex: one more: consider adding a short-lived tracing header from router->serving that is preserved across fallbacks so we can correlate traces without relying on client-supplied ids.
maya: sounds good. follow-ups: kevin RFC, alex telemetry PR, devex console mock, sara short-term alert. will check back after RFC review. :thumbsup:
